# orders-api configuration module

Generated by `docuconf terraform` from the `orders-api` contract. It takes one argument per input, checks it against the contract, and renders the container's `env`. See [spec/IAC.md](https://github.com/Docuconf/docuconf-go/blob/main/spec/IAC.md).

| Input | Type | Required | Set with | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | list of string, csv |  | `value`, `injected` | Origins allowed to call the API from a browser |
| `DATABASE_URL` | url, secret | yes | `secret`, `injected` | Postgres connection string for the orders database |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | enum |  | `value`, `config_map`, `injected` | Minimum log level emitted |
| `PORT` | int |  | `value`, `config_map`, `resource_field`, `injected` | HTTP listen port |
| `REQUEST_TIMEOUT` | duration |  | `value`, `config_map`, `injected` | Time limit for handling one request |
| `WEBHOOK_KEYS` | keySet, secret |  | `secret`, `injected` | Keys that verify the signature on incoming payment webhooks |
| `WORKER_COUNT` | int |  | `value`, `config_map`, `resource_field`, `injected` | Number of background workers processing orders |

### File inputs

| Input | Type | Path | Required | Set with | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `discounts` | config, yaml | `/etc/orders/discounts/discounts.yaml` |  | `inline`, `config_map`, `secret`, `csi`, `image`, `injected` | Discount codes accepted at checkout |
| `serving-tls` | tls, secret | `/etc/orders/tls` |  | `secret`, `certificate`, `csi`, `injected` | Certificate to serve HTTPS with. Without it, the service serves HTTP |

Some constraints are checked by `docuconf lint terraform` and at boot rather than in the module: a `json` input's or config file's schema, a TOML file's syntax, and anything about a secret's or reference's contents.

The module writes YAML with `yamlencode` and JSON compactly, so a ConfigMap's text, and the content hash in its name, can differ from what `docuconf render` and the Helm library chart write for the same values; the data they hold is the same. TOML inline content must be given as text: Terraform has no TOML encoder.

## Usage

```hcl
module "orders_api_config" {
  source = "./modules/orders-api-config"
  DATABASE_URL = { secret = { name = "orders-api", key = "database-url" } }
}
```

```hcl
dynamic "env" {
  for_each = module.orders_api_config.kubernetes_env
  content {
    name  = env.value.name
    value = env.value.value
    dynamic "value_from" {
      for_each = env.value.value_from == null ? [] : [env.value.value_from]
      content {
        dynamic "secret_key_ref" {
          for_each = value_from.value.secret_key_ref == null ? [] : [value_from.value.secret_key_ref]
          content {
            name = secret_key_ref.value.name
            key  = secret_key_ref.value.key
          }
        }
        dynamic "config_map_key_ref" {
          for_each = value_from.value.config_map_key_ref == null ? [] : [value_from.value.config_map_key_ref]
          content {
            name = config_map_key_ref.value.name
            key  = config_map_key_ref.value.key
          }
        }
        dynamic "field_ref" {
          for_each = value_from.value.field_ref == null ? [] : [value_from.value.field_ref]
          content { field_path = field_ref.value.field_path }
        }
        dynamic "resource_field_ref" {
          for_each = value_from.value.resource_field_ref == null ? [] : [value_from.value.resource_field_ref]
          content {
            resource       = resource_field_ref.value.resource
            divisor        = resource_field_ref.value.divisor
            container_name = resource_field_ref.value.container_name
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

and put `pod_annotations` and `pod_labels` on the pod template's `metadata`.

```hcl
  for_each = module.orders_api_config.kubernetes_config_maps

    name      = each.key
    namespace = var.namespace

  data      = each.value.data
  immutable = each.value.immutable
}
```

```hcl
  for_each = module.orders_api_config.kubernetes_volumes
  content {

    }
    dynamic "secret" {
      for_each = volume.value.secret == null ? [] : [volume.value.secret]
      content {
        secret_name  = secret.value.secret_name
        default_mode = secret.value.default_mode
        dynamic "items" {
          for_each = secret.value.items
          content {
            key  = items.value.key
            path = items.value.path
          }
        }
      }
    }
    dynamic "csi" {
      for_each = volume.value.csi == null ? [] : [volume.value.csi]
      content {

# in the container
dynamic "volume_mount" {
  for_each = module.orders_api_config.kubernetes_volume_mounts
  content {
    name       = volume_mount.value.name
    mount_path = volume_mount.value.mount_path
    read_only  = volume_mount.value.read_only
```

`restart_triggers` lists the ConfigMaps, Secrets and SecretProviderClasses whose change must restart the pods; hash their content into a pod template annotation, or hand the list to a reloader. An inline ConfigMap's name already changes with its content.

### With the Helm library chart

A platform that deploys with Helm and the [docuconf library chart](https://github.com/Docuconf/docuconf-go/tree/main/helm) passes `helm_values`, the same arguments in the chart's `docuconf:` vocabulary, instead of declaring the workload:

```hcl
resource "helm_release" "app" {
  name   = "app"
  chart  = "./chart"
  values = [yamlencode({ docuconf = module.app_config.helm_values })]
}
```

The chart renders the env, volumes and ConfigMaps and checks the values again with its `values.schema.json`; the module's checks run first, at plan.
